operations.description: Create a dashboard with note, timeseries, query_value and toplist widgets (POST /api/v1/dashboard).
Soft-delete a dashboard (DELETE /api/v1/dashboard/{dashboard_id}).
Get a dashboard (GET /api/v1/dashboard/{dashboard_id}).
List dashboards, newest modified first, with count/start paging, deleted filter and a canonical-only title query (GET /api/v1/dashboard).
Replace a dashboard; restricted_roles and is_read_only are enforced (PUT /api/v1/dashboard/{dashboard_id}).
Post an event to the event stream (POST /api/v1/events, 202).
Get one event (GET /api/v1/events/{event_id}).
List events in a time window (≤ 32 days) newest first, filtered by priority, sources and tags, aggregated by aggregation_key unless unaggregated (GET /api/v1/events).
Declare an incident (POST /api/v2/incidents, 201, JSON:API).
Get an incident by UUID or public id (GET /api/v2/incidents/{incident_id}).
List incidents newest first with page[size]/page[offset] (GET /api/v2/incidents).
Search incidents (state:, severity:, customer_impacted:, commander.handle:, free text, OR groups) with facets.
Update title, customer impact, state, severity or commander (PATCH /api/v2/incidents/{incident_id}, JSON:API).
Get metric metadata (GET /api/v1/metrics/{metric_name}).
List metrics that reported since `from`, filtered by host and tag_filter (GET /api/v1/metrics).
Query timeseries points with the documented grammar subset (GET /api/v1/query).
Submit metric series (POST /api/v2/series, 202); points outside [now-1h, now+10m] are dropped; dependent monitors are re-evaluated.
Create a monitor; metric/query alerts and composites are evaluated immediately against synthetic points (POST /api/v1/monitor).
Delete a monitor; refused while a composite references it unless force=true (DELETE /api/v1/monitor/{monitor_id}).
Get one monitor, optionally with per-group states (GET /api/v1/monitor/{monitor_id}).
List monitors ordered by id with name, scope-tag, monitor-tag and id_offset filters and optional page/page_size (GET /api/v1/monitor).
Search monitors with the Manage Monitors query subset (status:, type:, tag:, id:, creator:, muted:, priority:, free text, OR groups); returns facet counts and page metadata.
Partially update a monitor and re-evaluate it; restricted_roles are enforced (PUT /api/v1/monitor/{monitor_id}).
Validate a monitor definition without saving it; answers {} when valid (POST /api/v1/monitor/validate).
Virtual clock, organization and calling user with effective write permissions (canonical only).

error.message: Rate limit of 1000 requests per 60 seconds reached. Please try again later.

connections.title: Datadog-shaped REST subset (DD-API-KEY header, JSON bodies)
connections.instructions: Point the Datadog client's server or base URL at DATADOG_FIREDRILL_URL in the test process and send DD_API_KEY as the DD-API-KEY header; DD-APPLICATION-KEY is accepted but not checked. The calling user is the actor attribute datadogUserHandle (default: the seeded admin). Compatibility with official clients is not verified.
